doc: a data-movement kernel: transpose / permute / concat / slice copy of numel elements.
name: layout

doc: per-row normalisation over `channels` for `rows` rows: layernorm (mean, var, eps, gamma, beta) | rmsnorm (mean of squares, eps, gamma) | groupnorm handled as rows of a group.
name: row_norm
tensors: inputs x [rows, channels], gamma [channels], beta [channels] (layernorm); output y

doc: softmax over n along each of `rows` rows.
name: row_softmax
tensors: input x [rows, n]; output y [rows, n]

doc: sum / mean / max over each row.
name: reduce_rows

doc: y = a (op) b elementwise; broadcast: none (same shape) | row (b is one row of `inner` values repeated over the rows: a bias) | col (b holds `inner` values, one per row of a, each repeated along its row: a per-channel NCHW scale) | scalar.
name: binary
params: {"broadcast": "str: none | row | col | scalar", "inner": "int: length of b's row", "numel": "int", "op": "str: add | sub | mul | div | max | min"}
tensors: inputs a [numel], b [numel] (none) / [inner] (row, col) / [1] (scalar); output y [numel]

doc: y = fn(x) elementwise over numel elements (tiled), fn one of the activations.
name: unary
params: {"fn": "str: silu | gelu | gelu_tanh | quick_gelu | sigmoid | tanh | relu | relu6 | hardswish | hardsigmoid | exp | rsqrt | neg | cos | sin | erf", "numel": "int"}
tensors: input x [rows, 128] (numel = rows * 128 rounded up; pad lanes are zero); output y, same shape

doc: y[m, n] = act(x[m, k] @ W[n, k]^T + bias[n]). Any m, k, n: k is reduced in 128-element chunks inside the kernel (one accumulator), m and n are tiled by the kernel's loops. Linear, batched matmul, attention and convolution (implicit im2col) all lower to it.
name: gemm
params: {"act": "str: none | relu | silu | gelu_tanh (fused at the store)", "bias": "bool: add bias[n]", "k": "reduction", "m": "rows of x (tokens)", "n": "outputs"}
tensors: inputs x [m, k], w [n, k] (logical; pack it as the kernel needs), bias [n] (when bias); output y [m, n]
